correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts one- and two-support factorizations. The prime-power case follows from an exact congruence and the lower bound on beta. The odd-odd two-support case has n/beta(n)<2. In the even-odd case divisibility forces the odd exponent even, making n/beta(n)<3 while the integral quotient is odd. In both two-support cases quotient one contradicts the strict product bound. The packaged checker independently finds only 4 through two million and verifies the local inequalities on thousands of prime powers.
